name: Franko Heke
reason: A music act rather than a teacher: his own site presents him as a performing artist (concerts, kirtan, festivals, a booking agency, a songbook and clothing), and his YouTube channel is live performances and an interview podcast; the only teaching items are one 21-day voice course and free online sound ceremonies, and the site publishes no base. For the owner: the podcast's recent guests include Dr. Zach Bush and Terrence Howard.
